messages:
Sam P: Heads-up — Azura legal just pinged sales with a draft that requests 99.99% uptime + 24/7 phone/Slack support for their pilot. They want costs and an implementation sketch by EOD Friday.
Maria L: rough contract id?
Sam P: AZ-2026-PR1 attached in the email thread. Estimated 50 rps at peak, mostly short-chat generation. They said latency <150ms p95 if possible.
Jonah K: 99.99% for hosted API is heavy. Need to surface tradeoffs: multi-region active-active, reserved capacity, failover SLAs, and support tiers. Suggest we map to our Dedicated + premium support add-on.
Priya S: +1. Also call out fallback model variants and warmed caches. For p95 <150ms we'd recommend Dedicated with prewarmed pools and KV prefix cache. Hosted might hit 150ms only in ideal region coverage.
Maria L: can we give a single-page intake to sales? quick matrix: uptime / latency / support / recommended product + cost tier
Sam P: yes — I drafted a proposal below, please quick review. If we align, I'll send to sales to forward to Azura.
Sam P: ```
SLA Option A: 99.9% uptime | p95 latency target: 200ms | Support: business hours | Product: Hosted + Standard Support | Est: $X/mo
SLA Option B: 99.99% uptime | p95 latency target: 150ms | Support: 24/7 phone + dedicated CSM | Product: Dedicated (multi-region) + Premium Support + 2x warm pools | Est: $Y/mo
Implementation notes: DNS failover, active health checks, warm-AI pool, model pinning, canary rollouts, monthly reliability report
``` 
Jonah K: Nice. Add note about SLO burn rate alerting and automatic fallback to a lower-cost model variant with degraded latency/quality if capacity hit.
Priya S: Also include a spike protection clause and cold-start penalty explanation. Operations needs 72h notice for prewarming additional GPUs.
Maria L: can Ops commit to the 72h prewarm? @Ops-Bot any objections?
Ops-Bot: Auto-note: Prewarm request lead time is typically 72-96 hours depending on region and inventory. Emergency cross-zone capacity can be requested but incurs surge fees. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prewarm-policy
Sam P: Ok — action items: 1) Maria to create intake matrix for sales (sales-ready one-pager). 2) Jonah + Priya to add ops constraints and SLA tech appendix. 3) Sam to draft messaging and optional cost estimates. Target: get back to sales by Fri EOD. :thumbsup:
Maria L: I'll drop a one-pager in #sales-ops and link here when done.
Jonah K: I'll add a short appendix with fallback routing policy and alert thresholds.
Priya S: I'll scope prewarm costs and add the 72h language.
Sam P: Thanks team. If anyone hears pushback from Azura on price vs uptime, note that we can offer a canary with 99.95% for lower price and a six-week SLA ramp.
Maria L: noted.
Sam P: closing loop — will update thread with the final one-pager and send to sales.
